entries.summary: Tool-authorization approvals are Host-only by default (#1101): the control socket and byok-agent approve can no longer approve them; rejection is unaffected. Set DaemonConfig.localToolApproval: 'allow' to restore local tool-authorization approval.

Wire major 4 (#925). A v3 envelope is rejected; there is no v3 reader and no negotiation. conn.ack, the runtime-only and Agent offer variants (task.offer_for_agent*, task.offer_with_toolsets*, task.offer_prepared, task.offer_sealed) and every *_sealed envelope type are removed: an Agent offer is one task.offer, and sealed is a payload branch of the plain type. Drain the v3 deployment and start v4 server side and daemons together on a new store.

Wire major 4 (#925) in @byok-sdk/protocol. The removed offer and sealed type names (TaskOfferForAgent*, TaskOfferWithToolsets*, TaskOfferPrepared*, ConnAck*, TASK_OFFER_TYPES, isTaskOfferType, SealedMessageType, isSealedMessageType, STRICT_AGENT_ONLY_CAPABILITY) have no replacement alias: use TaskOfferPayload / TaskOfferPlainPayload with session, SealableMessageType, isSealableMessageType and isSealedPayload. PROTOCOL_VERSION, CAPABILITY_FLAGS, the payload schema registry and the approval payloads (approvalId required) change with it.

Wire major 4 (#925) in the client, cloud and server APIs. Git workspace mode and the daemon task workspace root are removed (ADR-034): every task runs in its Agent home; delete DaemonConfig.gitWorkspace, DaemonOverrides.gitWorkspace and DaemonConfig.workspaceRoot (they raise DaemonConfigFieldRemovedError), and the GitWorkspace* exports and the git-workspace daemon event are gone. DaemonConfig.strictAgentOnly is removed. Runtime adapters take RuntimeTaskInput instead of a wire offer payload. Daemon.approve/reject and ByokServer approvals require approvalId; ByokServer.tasks.approve/reject and tasks.events are new. cloud Enqueue*OfferInput and server LegacyDispatchInput are removed: dispatch Agent executions. DaemonConfig.toolAuthorization (#1061) and DaemonEvent claimed.admission (#1014) also land on these types.

K4 (examples/host-execution-core) and K8 (examples/bot-collaboration) source changed for wire v4 (#925), the approval channel (#1036) and the pre-launch compatibility cut (#1037; K8 drops promoteReplyReceipts). Their package version stays 0.0.1, so compare the src-sha256 in this entry: re-vendor both from this release, add session: { mode: "fresh" } wherever the Host builds an execution payload, and start the K4 ledger afresh.

One approval entry and one resolution point (#1036). The needs_approval AgentEvent and Session.resolveApproval are removed; an adapter that declares approvalInteractive asks through the ApprovalChannel it is handed. An exhaustive switch over AgentEvent loses the needs_approval case; activity and timeline schemas follow the AgentEvent union.

byok-agent retire-input-preparation and retireInputPreparation are removed with the five InputPreparationRetirement* errors and the retirement types (#1037). A daemon whose input-preparation record log holds an older record still refuses that lane at open: with the daemon stopped, move <storeDir>/input-preparation/ aside and start it again.

Pre-launch compatibility paths are removed (#1037). cloud-do tables declare every column in CREATE TABLE and no longer backfill older storage: RunRow.membershipPending, CloudState.pendingBackfills and applyBackfill are gone; clear local development state. The server SQLite storage migration option is removed (SqliteEmbeddedStoreOptions.migration).

The daemon journal (daemon.db) declares withheld_bytes in CREATE TABLE and no longer adds it to an older file (#1037). A journal written without the column is refused at open with JournalUnavailableError and left unchanged: preserve or export it and resolve it before starting this build.

The embedded server SQLite store moves to schema 6 to persist approval timelines across restarts (#1049), and no longer adopts older files or migration selectors (#1037). An older file is refused with SqliteSchemaError (SQLITE_SCHEMA_UNSUPPORTED) and left unchanged: start on a new state path and pair the daemons again.

TaskAttempt records offeredAt, claimedAt, firstOutputAt and terminalAt (#980). TaskAttemptStore gains the required recordFirstOutput: a Host that implements its own TaskAttemptStore or TenantStores must add it. Postgres adds migration 0030; apply it (migrate) before deploying the new stores. Older rows are accepted and not backfilled.

task.claim and task.decline may carry the device admission timings (OfferAdmissionTimings, bounded by OFFER_ADMISSION_MAX_DURATION_MS), and the terminal inference usage may name the provider model (TERMINAL_INFERENCE_USAGE_MODEL_MAX_LENGTH) (#1014). All fields are optional.

Tool authorization is hard-cut to auto | all (#1061). DaemonConfig.toolAuthorization takes a ToolAuthorizationResolver; auto routes high-risk calls through awaiting-approval, all reports them with the new tool-reminder daemon event. RuntimeCapabilities and the Pi adapter options change with it (Agent-scoped Pi tools and resources, #1067/#1076). An exhaustive switch over DaemonEvent must handle tool-reminder.
A Host MCP toolset may pre-approve named tools (mcpServers[].approveTools, mcpToolApprovals), and an adapter descriptor may declare mcpToolApprovals (#1072). All fields are optional.

ExpiringClassId and RetentionClassId gain agent-result, so an exhaustive switch over them must handle it (#1009). ClassUsage.truncated is required. storage.retention.ttlMs["agent-result"] defaults to 7 days.

ByokServer.tasks.events(taskId) follows one task feed with resumable cursors (#1022); TaskEventEntry and TaskEventsUnavailableError are new. TaskHandle.events() reads the same feed: a read after the terminal feed is reclaimed throws TaskEventsUnavailableError (feed_expired) where it used to complete empty, and the await_approval ServerTaskEvent requires approvalId.
New browser-safe entry @byok-sdk/keys/model-route: the headless logic of a Pi model route page (#988). Nothing existing changes.
PiModelConfigSchema.compat accepts sendSessionAffinityHeaders and allowEmptySignature as pinned pi-ai 1.4.0 reads them (#987); the provider profile schema accepts the wider compat object.

The Postgres stores accept only a pool from createByokPool, which returns the new ByokPool type (#1040). The option types and positional store constructors take pool: ByokPool, and the compositions throw TypeError for a bare pg.Pool. Build every pool with createByokPool.
